method: Inspected a decoded frame from each of ten chapters, a full-size maintenance receipt frame and a full-size native before/after frame, following automated full-stream decode. This is sampled visual inspection, not a claim of watching every frame.
findings: All ten chapters are present with matching caption bands.
Captions fit below the viewport and do not cover application pixels.
Actual native park and static before/after images are visible; synthetic action boundaries remain explicit.
The accepted maintenance work order is followed by an independently observed closed ride.
Design closure and unresolved step-free entrance both show unreachable results.
Export and final evidence/limits chapter remain visible after the measured tail clipping.
timing_limit: Capture-to-first-encoded-frame alignment is approximate; 0.218 seconds beyond the measured raw container were explicitly excluded, with no padded tail or speed change.
